description: European Medicines Agency Periodic Safety Update Report Single Assessments (PSUSA) — the EU-wide pharmacovigilance procedure where all products containing a given active substance are jointly reassessed for safety on a fixed schedule. Returns the active substance, related medicine names, procedure number, regulatory outcome (e.g. "Maintenance", "Variation", "Suspension") and dates. The closest structured EU signal to a pharmacovigilance safety review. Answers "when was the last PSUSA outcome for X", "has ibuprofen had a periodic safety update review", "recent EU pharmacovigilance outcomes".

outcome.description: Filter on regulatory outcome, e.g. "Maintenance", "Variation", "Suspension", "Withdrawal". Substring match.

query.description: Free text: active substance or related medicine name.

since.description: Earliest first-published date. YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY-MM or YYYY.

name: ema_psusa
title: Ema Psusa
